prompt:
Produce up to 4 distinct, useful design or engineering actions for the task below. Explore materially different mechanisms, including non-obvious alternatives. Respect every constraint. Give executable changes in the target domain, with an implementation step and a falsifiable check. Do not claim unmeasured gains, invent supporting facts, or rename the same action several ways. State actions in the user's terms; omit donor names and analogy explanations from the answer. Fewer actions, including none, are acceptable when no additional valid action remains. Keep each action compact: aim for 60–80 words TOTAL across its five fields, never more than 110. Suggested field budgets: action 8 words, mechanism 16, implementation 22, check 20, risk 10. The 110-word maximum applies to the SUM of all five values, not to each field.

Task:
{
  "title": "Bulk changes with intelligible scope",
  "brief": "A volunteer coordinator bulk-edits statuses for 600 records across filtered pages. People confuse the 25 visible rows with all 600 matching rows, and some records change before the operation finishes.",
  "constraints": [
    "The backend accepts explicit record IDs and returns per-record outcomes.",
    "No operation may include an ID absent from the user's confirmed set.",
    "Support a screen reader and no pointer.",
    "Reversal is possible for ten minutes only when the record has not subsequently changed."
  ],
  "success_criteria": [
    "The confirmed scope is visible and unambiguous.",
    "Partial failures can be recovered without reapplying successful changes.",
    "Users can understand why a particular reversal is unavailable."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Changing the ten-minute policy or using a blocking review of 600 individual rows."
  ]
}
Optional outside cue:
Donor domain: Astronomical adaptive optics
Relation: A nearby reference is repeatedly measured to estimate a changing disturbance. A corrector adjusts the signal path using that measured error while leaving the underlying target separate from the correction. The loop must run quickly enough to follow the disturbance it is meant to remove.
Boundary: The reference must experience a sufficiently similar disturbance. An old or unrepresentative reference can produce the wrong correction; a feedback loop does not make its measurement truthful.
Treat the relation as an optional prompt for exploration. Transfer useful relationships, not surface nouns. The donor is not evidence that a target intervention will work. Ignore the cue if it cannot support a valid move.

Return JSON only: {"actions":[{"action":"...","mechanism":"...","implementation":"...","check":"...","risk":"..."}],"abstention_reason":""}. Use abstention_reason only to explain an empty action list. No tools or additional research.
